dynamicMenu.label: Apply code
dynamicMenu.supertip: Codes the selected text: your codes, the ones you used last first.

button.label: Find code
button.supertip: Type to find a code, Enter applies it to the selected text.

button.label: New code
button.supertip: Creates a code (name, colour, description) and applies it to the selected text.

button.label: In vivo
button.supertip: Creates a code named after the selected text and applies it.

button.label: Insert quote
button.supertip: Type to find a coded passage; Enter inserts it at the cursor as a quote, linked to its source.

button.label: Insert artifact
button.supertip: Type to find an artifact; Enter inserts its picture or its interpretation at the cursor.

button.label: Find and insert
button.supertip: Type to find a quote, an artifact, a note, a table or a figure, and insert it at the cursor.

button.label: Refresh
button.supertip: Updates every linked quote, figure and table in the document from its source.

button.label: Unlink all
button.supertip: Keeps the quotes, figures and tables as they are, without their links: Refresh no longer updates them.

button.label: Open Yaqatw
button.supertip: Opens Yaqatw in a Clew Desktop window, working on this document.

button.label: Connection
button.supertip: Shows whether Yaqatw for Word is connected to Clew Desktop, and connects it again if needed.
